# Deploy Vespa | (Just Updated) Vector + Hybrid Search Engine, Ready to Feed on Railway

Hybrid keyword + vector search engine, sample app ready to feed

[![Deploy on Railway](https://railway.com/button.svg)](https://railway.com/deploy/vespa-or-just-updated-vector-hybrid-sear)

## About

Vespa is an open-source search and vector database engine that serves text (BM25), vector (HNSW nearest-neighbor) and hybrid queries from one system. This template runs a single-node Vespa from a digest-pinned image with a sample application already deployed, so the document API and the search API answer as soon as the service is healthy.

Vespa expects to be its own config server and container, and it runs as a non-root user. The start command handles what Railway needs:

- **Writable state.** Railway mounts volumes root-owned. The service starts as root, fixes ownership of `/opt/vespa/var`, then drops to the `vespa` user. Config, indexes and documents persist across redeploys.
- **Sample application.** On first boot a small application is deployed: schema `doc` with `title` and `text` (BM25) and a 384-dimension `embedding` (HNSW, angular), plus rank profiles `bm25` and `hybrid`. If an application is already on the volume, it is left untouched on later boots.
- **Single-node hostname.** The node name is pinned so the config server and container find each other after every restart.
- **Public API on 8080.** The document and query API is served on Railway's injected port. The config server (19071) stays internal.

To use your own schema, deploy your application package to the config server over the private network.

## Configuration

- **Start command:** `/bin/sh -c 'echo  | base64 -d > /tmp/boot.sh; exec sh /tmp/boot.sh'`
- **Networking:** Public domain with automatic HTTPS
- **Volume:** `/opt/vespa/var`

**Category:** AI/ML
